lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Folks at home... we here at ZTV *do not* condone child violence!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: We will, however, continue to bring it to you live in high-definition all thanks to our sponsors at HETAP: "When you're feeling sapped, bring the TAP!"

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: At some point, Cell's hand is going to cramp up, and then Gohan will—

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan! Look out for low kicks!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You're quite a treat to knock around, kid… durable like your father, but soft like your mother.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But if you think the only way to win is to not play, I have news for you, brat: You're playing the wrong game!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Your precious runt is becoming a man.'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Yeah, but… I mean, he could be dodging better.'

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: This eleven-year-old child is currently fighting for his life!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Methinks the Make-A-Wish Foundation has gone too far this time!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Can we show that on network television?

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: Baby! Sweetheart, remember! You have another one coming!

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: ♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: ♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Soooo, which one of you wants to try and describe the word "filicide" to Goku?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'd ask Gohan, but… well, he's been "filicided".

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm actually not sure what it means either.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I think it's when you murder a pony?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Stop hiding your power level and come on out, you goof!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I've been humoring you this entire time anyway, so why not?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But if you're looking to exchange barbs, I'd recommend cutting your teeth on something simpler first… like that embarrassment over there.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I know why my Dad threw me to the biggest wolf in the woods.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, trust me! I'll huff and puff and blow you down.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: It's because whenever I get backed into a corner… I snap.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And when I do… I hurt people.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: When I get angry... when I lose my mind… my power skyrockets and… everything goes red.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The world around me just… fades away.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And all I can see is the person I want to kill.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Of course, I've never actually managed to beat anyone in the past, but… I think my Dad knows that… if I snap here…

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Well, threaten me with a good time!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: At first, you had my curiosity… but now you have my erection.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You all know what I'm about!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: The one he killed Vegeta with!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You should really watch out for that.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: "THEN YOU SHOULD REALLY WATCH OUT FOR THAT!"

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: What's that? Is that a club? Can I join?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So to be clear - when you break, I die!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Is that the gist of it?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: That would be the process of events, yes.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Well, then… let's see which breaks first.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: In this endless pile of hay, Goku, THIS is the last straw!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: If you don't go out there, your son— your flesh and blood will *die*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Speaking of butts, which way do you think his organs are gonna come out?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Because I'm betting mouth, but I'm hoping…

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I get what you're saying, but this is exactly what I've been planning out this whole time!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Why do you think Gohan and I went into the Time Chamber *after* Vegeta and Trunks?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Because if Gohan and I came out first, we'd've killed Cell right away.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: But leaving that job to Vegeta?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well… I mean, you saw what happened.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I'm… confused, because it sounds like you *knew* Vegeta would screw up.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, it was gonna be him or Krillin.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: B-b-but how did you know he wouldn't just kill everyone after becoming perfect?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Cell would never pass that up… because I wouldn't.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Piccolo… I ain't gonna be around forever.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sooner or later, death is gonna… stick, y'know?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Someone's gotta be here when I'm not.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And when I was in the Chamber with him, I realized that… that person… is Gohan.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Listen to those bones crackling and popping… so where's the *snap*, kiddo?!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Well… seems like you thought of almost everything.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I just treated it like one big fight.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Unfortunately, you skipped one small detail.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Have you ever, in your life, actually asked your son what he likes?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Umm… but he went in that Chamber with me for that whole year.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Because he wanted to spend time with YOU - his FATHER - the man who spends half his time training, and the other half dead!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Krillin, I need another Senzu bean.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Krillin, I'm serious! I'm gonna use it on me this time!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: "Krillin, I'm serious! I'm gonna use it on me this time!"

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Uh, just a quick update, everyone; These are now tournament illegal.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I have done literally nothing wrong.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I see now that not all roads lead to Rome.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Torture won't do the trick, so let's change up the game plan, shall we?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'm going to drag each one of *them* down here and murder them until you finally give me what I want.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'll save your dad for last.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I mean, if you're just gonna say it—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Listen, buddy, I'm thrilled that you're finally coming around to me, but your timing is less than ideal!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: And the Jolly Green Ginger has got Cell in a bear hug!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Within me is a high-yield nuclear explosive.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: I am going to self-destruct and take Cell with me.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I do not consent to this!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You had a chunk of your head missing!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait! You don't have to do this, bro-bot!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You still have so much to live for!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: If I do not do this, Cell will continue to kill and destroy.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: If I cannot kill Goku, nobody will kill Goku!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: You cannot talk your way out of this one, Cell.

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: What are the odds of outrunning a nuclear explosion?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You're being really selfish right now!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: One more time, for old times' sake.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: There was supposed to be a Cell-shattering "kaboom"!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: My Mom said she took out your bomb during repairs!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Well, Sixteen, not that this long embrace hasn't been heartwarming and all—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: my endorphins are just going crazy right now—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: but I have a child to break.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now, if I'm correct, you were looking for a…

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: If I said "no", would you still—?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: If I knew he was gonna go nuclear on Cell, I'd have left the stupid thing in him!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Why'd you even take it out in the first place?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Imagine if he decided to blow his payload the first time he saw Goku!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: "Whoops, sorry I let your husband and child get nuked, but the Hippocratic oath and all that."

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Bulma, I think you need to relax more.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Well, then, two of us are thirsty!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, Sixteen… I wanted you to be the wind beneath my wings, but all you've done is take the wind out of my sails.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now I don't even feel like killing these fools.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yes, kiddo, I'm not going to kill your daddies.

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen at home, the terrible Cell is now… doing one of two things—I'm pretty sure we can't show either on network television.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You all did this to me!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I don't get what Chi-Chi was complaining about!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That's gonna be doing that the rest of the day.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Goku, I've decided that your insistence on fighting your progeny would be best returned in kind.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Norio, Dameon, Travis, Curtis, Dale, and Jonathan.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: It's like every nightmare I've ever had fused into one,

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: cloned itself, f***ed the clone and then made THOSE!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Daddy's set up a play date for you!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now make sure you share your toys, don't leave Daddy's sight… and bring me the bodies.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: We are NOT calling them that!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Are they not precious, my own little family?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now after I'm through with this worthless little planet, I'll have someone to accompany me as I trounce about the stars.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Perhaps I'll try conquering Namek… wear that hat for a little while.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yeah, you're right. That's the Freeza talking.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So tell me, Goku: Where does THIS fit into your master plan?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, you know what they say: "Everyone has a plan until they get punched in the—"

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I take back what I said about my hidden power!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: This is my Dad's fight, not mine!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So I'm begging you, just rein them in!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Give my dad a Senzu bean and—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That right there… *that* is why I *despise* you.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You know what they all have in common?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: The Saiyans might be fools, the humans might be weak, and the Namekian might not belong… but they're still out there fighting.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Not just for their lives, but for this *dung hill* of a world.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: See? Even Krillin's doing his best!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But none of them, boy—NOT A ONE— shares that trait with you so vile, it drives me to retch(!)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So a coward patting himself on the back.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Congratulations, pint-size, you can stand proud next to the bodies.

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Dear viewers, it looks like Cell's gone full septo-mom, with seven sinister spawns!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Mr. Satan, do you have a plan to deal with these terrifying toddlers?

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: Uhh… y'see, Jimmy, those aren't actually children.

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: They're dwarves paid to fight on his behalf!

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: And honestly, I bet you they ain't even payin' 'em industry rates!

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: I tell ya, Jimmy, the way little people are treated in show business… oh, it's downright criminal!

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: I-I'm gonna go right now and look up their agents, and give 'em a piece of my—

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: I seem to be without a body.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Would you mind lending me yours?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: I need one of you to give me a hand.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: I must get close to Cell and the boy, so one of you will need to get me there.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: I believe that I know a way to finally put an end to this madness.

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: What makes you think we're going anywhere *near* that war zone?!

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: I have a daughter at home, Jimmy.

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: A little girl about the age of that boy out there.

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: And right now, I'm being told I might be able to save the world, and all I gotta do is throw this robot's head in spitting distance of that crazy killer bug-monster?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: I have been finding God throughout this entire experience.

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: Well then, who better to leave it to than the World Martial Arts champ, Mr. Satan?

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: And besides, what'd I tell you, Jimmy?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: They are not. You could die.

lines.speaker: Mister Satan
lines.text: Do you have a mute button or something?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: 'Damien sure is kicking the shit out of Yamcha.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm gonna… I'm gonna… r-rip off your head and… umm—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, yeah? C'mon, c'mon, you can do it.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now you're just embarrassing us both.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Seriously, *how hard* is it to piss off an eleven-year-old?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You should be a stomping mess from me taking a toy away!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Meanwhile, your friends and family are getting beaten into mulch, and all you can do is… cry??

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That's it—kids, put your toys away. We're going home.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And to be clear, I mean "kill them all so I can blow up this shithole and find something better to do".

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm just one step closer to the edge, and I'm about to—!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Everything! You say to me! Is pissing me off!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And in the end… it didn't even matter.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Kids, when you're done with them,

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: As for you, I'm surprised you're still…

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: …well, I was going to say "kicking", but—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Alright, fine, fine then. You talk to him, Jesus.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: You act like you are the only one suffering, but I believe that Trunks has some stories for you.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: And I can assume they all end with, "And then he died, too."

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: And before you start whining about your father, again—and I get it— take a moment to consider that my father made me a soulless killing machine to kill your father.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: And that doesn't even come close to the complete tragedy of fatherhood that is Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You wanna come up here and say that?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Then maybe you should quit while you are!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: You think you're better than everyone else, but there you stand: the good man doing nothing.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: And while evil triumphs, and your rigid pacifism crumbles into blood-stained dust, the only victory afforded to you is that you stuck true to your guns.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: You were a coward… to your last whimper.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Of fear and love, I fear not that I will die, but that all I have come to love: the birds, and the things that are not birds, will perish with me.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: So please… Gohan… stop holding back.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: And hey, if we do make it out of this, please pick up my head... AND BEAT YOUR FATHER TO DEATH WITH—!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'd say he's gone to a better place, but… we both know he never had a soul.

segments.title: Filicide
segments.quote: Which one of you wants to try and describe the word "filicide" to Goku? / I think it's when you murder a pony? / IT MEANS GOHAN IS DEAD…!

segments.title: You Have My Erection
segments.quote: At first, you had my curiosity… but now you have my erection.

segments.title: Remember That, Vegeta?
segments.quote: That's Freeza's move! The one he killed Vegeta with! Remember that, Vegeta? / I was there.

segments.title: Just According to Cake
segments.quote: Well, then… let's see which breaks first. / 'Just according to cake.'

segments.title: One Small Detail
segments.quote: Unfortunately, you skipped one small detail. / Whuzzat? / *GOHAN DOESN'T LIKE FIGHTING, YOU MORON*!!

segments.title: I've Made a Terrible Mistake
segments.quote: "OH, I'VE MADE A TERRIBLE MISTAKE!" That's you! ... "Krillin, I'm serious! I'm gonna use it on me this time!" That's you.

segments.title: Where There's Smoke, There's Firecracker
segments.quote: "Where there's smoke, there's Firecracker," sir. / You're goddamn right. ... A critical error has occurred. Where's the "kaboom"!?

segments.title: Life, Uh, Finds a Way
segments.quote: I don't understand! Where's the egg?! / "Life, uh… finds a way…" / …to make me vomit!

segments.title: Vegeta Junior… Junior
segments.quote: Norio, Dameon, Travis, Curtis, Dale, and Jonathan. Oh, and of course… Vegeta Junior… Junior. / Veeeegeeeetaaaa…

segments.title: So Are You
segments.quote: Why are you screaming? / Because you're a talking head! / So are you. / That… is cutting, sir.

segments.title: Defecate on Your Lunch
segments.quote: I'm gonna… I'm gonna… r-rip off your head and… umm— …and… and defecate… …on your… lunch? / Now you're just embarrassing us both.

segments.title: The Birds, and the Things That Are Not Birds
segments.quote: …but that all I have come to love: the birds, and the things that are not birds, will perish with me. So please… Gohan… stop holding back.
